title: Closest Approach
body: A truck is traveling east at $$80\, \tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{hr}}$$. $$At$$ $$an$$ $$intersection$$ $$32\, \text{km}$$ ahead (east) of the truck, a car is traveling north at $$50\, \tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{hr}}$$, $$leaving$$ $$the$$ $$intersection$$ $$at$$ $$this$$ $$instant$$.
lesson: 4. Motion in Two and Three Dimensions
